case_studies.title: WinstaAI — Production AI SaaS Platform (KLIKY AI)
case_studies.challenge: Build a production AI SaaS platform for Instagram content generation with multi-tenant isolation, credit-based usage metering, and async GPU inference queuing.
case_studies.solution: FastAPI async API, LangChain orchestration, PostgreSQL RLS for tenant isolation, Stripe metered billing, Celery for GPU inference queue, React dashboard.

case_studies.title: US Startup — Full-Stack MVP in 8 Weeks
case_studies.challenge: US startup needed a senior software developer to build their MVP in 8 weeks — full-stack, async remote delivery, zero in-person meetings.
case_studies.solution: Milestone-based delivery, weekly Loom demos, Next.js frontend + FastAPI backend + Stripe billing + PostgreSQL, Docker deployment on AWS.

case_studies.title: Enterprise API Modernization — Legacy to FastAPI
case_studies.challenge: Enterprise needed to modernize a legacy PHP monolith to a FastAPI microservices architecture without disrupting existing users.
case_studies.solution: Strangler Fig pattern: new FastAPI services alongside legacy, API gateway routing, zero-downtime Alembic migrations, comprehensive pytest suite.

evaluation_criteria: GitHub commit history (consistent, not sporadic bursts)
Live application performance (Lighthouse, API response times)
Specific technical answers (not generic 'I can do anything')

engagement_models.hourly: Exploratory work, audits, undefined scope — $29/hr, min 4hrs
engagement_models.fixed_price: Defined MVP or feature with clear spec — from $4,999
engagement_models.audit: Codebase review, security, architecture — $699 flat fee

red_flags: No GitHub profile or sparse commit history
Can't explain multi-tenancy or Stripe webhook idempotency
No test files in portfolio repositories
